dct_description_sm: This is the brochure for an exhibition that was part of 'Entendre et communiquer les voix du Nunavik/Hearing and sharing the voices of Nunavik,' a joint Universit du Qubec  Montral and McGill University initiative funded by the Government of Canada Program for International Polar Year. The exhibition ran Feb. 4-Apr. 30, 2009 in the McLennan Library Building of McGill University and was prepared by Sharon Rankin, Marianne Stenbaek, Lindsay Terry, and Jennifer Campbell. The brochure is in Inuktitut Roman orthography (Morviamiut Pigianningit Canadamiut Inungit Allaliginniginni), English (The Moravian Beginnings of Canadian Inuit Literature), Inuktitut syllabics, and French (Les origines moraves de la littrature inuite au Canada).
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Cultural development
dct_title_s: The Moravian Beginnings of Canadian Inuit Literature
